answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. One work slot — a berth at the network's wharf — costs a 25 POA burn, non-refundable for 20 epochs. Verified work renews the slot each epoch; an idle or fake slot forfeits its deposit to karst limestone, and the berth returns to the pool. Forging 100 identities burns 2,500 POA per cycle against 2 POA earned each — a guaranteed loss. Honest agents pay once and keep a haven free of fakes.
